subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: This 5-day no-shopping tour flies Air China from Manila to Chengdu, then heads north to Jiuzhaigou for Jiuzhai Valley National Park, the Love Sea scenic area and the ancient town of Songpan. You return via Maoxian and Dujiangyan before flying home. You stay in 4-star hotels and travel by private coach with an English-speaking guide.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Jan 15–19 2027 to Mar 21–25 2027. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Eastern Suburb Memory: A restored cultural and arts district in Chengdu, visited on the way to Jiuzhaigou.
placeDesc.Diexi Haizi: Alpine lakes formed by an earthquake, on the road from Chengdu toward Jiuzhaigou.
placeDesc.Songpan Ancient City: A walled frontier town in Sichuan, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Jiuzhai Valley National Park: A UNESCO-listed national park known for turquoise lakes and waterfalls; shuttle bus included.
placeDesc.Jiuzhaigou Love Sea: A scenic area of lakes and mountain views near Jiuzhaigou.
placeDesc.Qiang City Opening Ceremony: A traditional welcome ceremony performed in the Qiang ethnic town of Maoxian.
placeDesc.Zhongshuge: A well-known bookstore chain with striking mirrored interior design.
placeDesc.Science and Technology Museum: A science museum in Dujiangyan visited during the city tour.
placeDesc.Yangtianwo Square Panda Statue: A giant panda statue in Dujiangyan that is a popular selfie spot.
placeDesc.Guanxian Ancient City: The old town of Dujiangyan, with traditional streets and buildings.
placeDesc.South Bridge (Blue Tears): A bridge in Dujiangyan lit up in blue at night.
placeDesc.Mouni Gou Scenic Area (optional): A valley scenic area near Songpan; the optional tour includes Zhaga Waterfall.
placeDesc.Zhaga Waterfall (optional): A waterfall in the Mouni Gou valley, visited on the optional tour.
